title: Pure Paradox Bone Nail
text: On the Advanced Assembly Table, put the previous-stage weapon at the left node, Omni Microcore at the middle and Paradox Ore at the right. The six surface ingredients are Paradox Dust. Damage, enchantments, custom names and loaded crystals are retained.
Upgrade 4: 16 damage, 2.2 attack speed, 24 total healing and 200% base special range. Paradox motes increase with level.
§b§oAt least upgrading needs no smithing template)§r
